recovery_step: User manually sets ordinary power switch OFF once, keeps USB connected, waits about10s, reports screen/lamp. No battery removal or repeated cycling.
basis: Normal shutdown selected as the smallest manual recovery action after all logged host calls returned, old MSC objects disposed, no SERVICE object opened, no firmware/upload/file command, normal shooting UI and user-confirmed idle lamp. This does not prove camera internal work is finished or guarantee service exit.
authorization: Existing continuing research/recovery instruction and blanket consent; not a restart of consumed261 trial.
expected_next_evidence: User screen/lamp response; screen off alone does not establish MSC return because USB can remain powered.
